# Codec Class

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CodecClass`](gmeow-CodecClass.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CodecClass>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)

The capability class of a transform codec — encode, compress, or encrypt (spec §8). Determines the degradation path when the capability is missing: unknown-codec or missing-key opacity.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CodecClass`](gmeow-CodecClass.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
